# bitstyles_phoenix v3.0.0 - Table of Contents

A collection of Elixir phoenix helpers for bitstyles

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [BitstylesPhoenix](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [LICENSE](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/license.md)

## Modules

- [BitstylesPhoenix](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.md): Documentation for BitstylesPhoenix.

- Helpers
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Helper.Classnames](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Helper.Classnames.md): The very best of NPM, now for elixir.

- Components
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Avatar](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Avatar.md): An Avatar component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Badge](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Badge.md): The Badge component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Breadcrumbs](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Breadcrumbs.md): The Breadcrumbs component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Button](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Button.md): The button component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Card](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Card.md): A Card component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Content](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Content.md): The Content component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.DescriptionList](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.DescriptionList.md): The description list components.
## With items (short-cut form)
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Dropdown](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Dropdown.md): The dropdown component without any JS.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Error](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Error.md): Component for showing UI errors.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Flash](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Flash.md): Component for building flash messages.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Form](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Form.md): Components for rendering input elements.
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Heading](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Heading.md): Components for building headings.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Icon](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Icon.md): An SVG icon system, that expects the icons to be present on the page, rendered as SVG `<symbol>`s.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Modal](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Modal.md): The Modal component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Sidebar](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Sidebar.md): The sidebar component without any JS.
## Sidebar with items
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Tabs](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.Tabs.md): The Tabs component.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Component.UseSVG](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Component.UseSVG.md): Components for rendering SVGs.

- Live components
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Live](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Live.md): Use this module to import all `BitstylesPhoenix.Live` components at once.
```
use BitstylesPhoenix.Live
```

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Live.Dropdown](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Live.Dropdown.md): Components for rendering a drowdowns powered by LiveView commands.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Live.Sidebar](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Live.Sidebar.md): Components for rendering a sidebar layout powered by LiveView commands.

- Alpine components
  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3.md): Use this module to import all `BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3` components at once.
```
use BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine
```

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3.Dropdown](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3.Dropdown.md): Components for rendering a dropdown menu powered by Alpine 3.

  - [BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3.Sidebar](https://bitstyles-phoenix.hexdocs.pm/BitstylesPhoenix.Alpine3.Sidebar.md): Components for rendering a sidebar layout powered by Alpine 3.
